about_the_game:
Make Bad Choices, Create Chaos!

Drink, stumble, steal, and smash your way through a world where bad decisions lead to the best stories. Lose control, unlock absurd antics, and turn your neighborhood into your personal playground.

This free demo has some introductory content from the full game and doesn't include multiplayer.

Demo Features

🤪 Do Stupid Things – Just because you can (and the drunker you are, the worse they get)

🍷 Alcohol Crafting – Craft your own drinks, consume them yourself or sell for profit.

🏠 Limited Open Map – Every house is enterable (invited or not).

🥴 Survival Stats (Incl. BAC) – Because managing drunkenness is a skill

🛋️ Interact with Everything – Move, use, or mess with almost any object

🍻 Character Customization – Create your perfect (or perfectly drunk) self

💰 In-Game Economy – Earn, spend, and probably waste money

🎭 Drunken Expression – Dance, rant, or embrace chaos

🍳 Drunk Cooking – Master the fine art of inebriated cuisine

What You Can Do:


Chug another beer and watch the world bend to your drunken logic. The more you drink, the more stupid things you can do! Raid a house and walk away with an entire barbecue grill—if you can carry it, it's yours! Climb rooftops or ride a stolen shopping cart straight into trouble. Will you remember it tomorrow? Probably not.

Raid their fridge, crash their party or light the barbecue on fire at 3 a.m. See how long you can get away with it before someone calls the cop.

Sip a beer and casually prank your neighbors, or down moonshine and turn the entire town upside down. Whether you’re a harmless drunk or a full-blown menace is up to you. 


Will You Become a Local Legend?
Wreak havoc, pull off legendary stunts, drive drunk, and make sure the NPCs never forget your drunken adventures. No consequences, no regrets—just a whole lot of chaos.


Grab a (virtual) drink, stumble into the unknown, and make a glorious mess in the ultimate sandbox of drunken stupidity!

content_descriptors.notes: Drunkard Simulator features depictions of alcohol consumption and intoxicated behavior, as well as some nudity and strong language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 2500x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-10500 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or Radeon RX 5700 XT or Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Drink. Stumble. Cause chaos. Drunkard Simulator lets you turn your neighborhood into a boozy playground of impulsive stunts and slapstick mayhem.
